Title: 3 Triggers Behind Reactive Hypoglycemia (Even Without Diabetes)

Description:
Shaky, sweaty, or lightheaded 2-4 hours after eating? That's a classic sign of reactive hypoglycemia - a blood sugar crash that can happen even without diabetes. A fast glucose spike triggers an oversized insulin response, and blood sugar drops below normal.

White rice, pasta, and bread, candy and sugary drinks, and for some people, a history of stomach surgery, are common triggers. Pairing carbs with protein and fat, and eating smaller meals every 3-4 hours, helps keep blood sugar steadier.
